security_note: SMNRW is the public warrant on Semnur Pharmaceuticals (common SMNR), formed via Denali Capital SPAC merger closed September 22, 2025. Semnur is ~87.5% owned by Scilex Holding (SCLX). Pipeline shown is the underlying issuer's.

website.note: Single-asset company; SP-102 (SEMDEXA) is the lead and only clinical-stage program.

ctgov.note: C.L.E.A.R.-2 Phase 3 confirmatory study not yet listed under Semnur as lead sponsor at time of fetch.

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled epidural injection in patients with chronic LRP
indications.trial_status: Funded ($20M PIPE Sept 2025); confirmatory Phase 3 to support NDA filing targeted 2026, potential launch 2027. First Phase 3 (NCT03372161) and Phase 2 repeat-dose (NCT03613662) completed.
key_milestones: First Phase 3 met primary endpoint (data published Pain Journal 2024)
